Saved three tasks in [orders.json](orders.json). The orders set `wake: false`.
[Review #358](https://github.com/Kucze3205/ConnectWithLabview/issues/358#issuecomment-6710019266) found that removing the reason comparison still passes the runner check.
The first task adds a control and repeats four failure probes. Independent review must accept the fix before pinning.
[Lineage pilot #359](https://github.com/Kucze3205/ConnectWithLabview/issues/359#issuecomment-6710033821) proposes seven related groups and six unresolved groups.
The second task reviews these decisions and defines the permitted next scope. Machine timings do not measure review effort.
The third task reviews the replacement [store record](../benchmark/split/store-readiness-268.redacted.json) before store use.
Owner completion of request #345 does not replace this independent review.
[Startup diagnostics](startup.json) show no budget notice.
Benchmark quality remains unmeasured. Native evidence, typedef-impact cases and diagram-difference cases remain missing.
The owner has not accepted the verification method. Product implementation remains gated.

## What next
Read the three task results. Order independent review of the runner fix and act on both review verdicts.
Keep unresolved lineage relationships visible. Do not apply pilot decisions automatically to unexamined groups.
Do not repeat the manifest comparison, pilot inventory measurement or historical searches for the missing store record.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
